### 1. Key Industry Software Tools

#### **AI Repurposing & Clipping (Shorts/Reels)**
*   **Opus Clip:** An industry-standard generative AI video tool that repurposes long-form videos into 10+ viral shorts, reels, or TikToks with a single click. It features AI curation, auto-framing, and dynamic captions. According to creator economy reviews, it is one of the fastest ways to extract high-performing moments from podcasts or tutorials.
